title: The wells that named the valley
text: Indian Wells Valley is named for Indian Wells, a set of springs on its western border. The old stage route from Mojave to Keeler runs along the western border of the valley, past those springs. The Los Angeles Aqueduct, which carries water from the Owens Valley to Los Angeles, has been cut into the escarpment of the Sierra Nevada from Little Lake to Indian Wells.
